title: [BUG] Use LTM
body:


linked_prs.title: docs: fix long term memory class name in examples
linked_prs.body:
Fix documentation to match actual implementation of Long Term Memory.

The documentation was showing EnhanceLongTermMemory class which doesn't exist in the codebase. Updated to show LongTermMemory which is the correct class to use.

Fixes #2026

Link to Devin run: https://app.devin.ai/sessions/460b70be72c54909be40a086f738f333
Requested by: Joe

ai_judgment.response:
Yes.  
This issue concerns memory initialization and memory content errors in an LLM-based agent system (CrewAI), specifically with long-term memory components and their storage classes. It matches the "Memory initialization issues" and "Memory dependency issues" subcategories in the agent issue taxonomy.
